events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on September 26, 1969, in the UK, and October 1, 1969, in the US.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That zebra crossing, those four lads... 'Abbey Road' dropped this week in '69. What's your go-to track from The Beatles' final recorded album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! From 'Brass in Pocket' to her enduring rock legacy, what's your favourite Pretenders moment?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's the ultimate Oasis or solo track that gets you singing along?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' the album dropped around this time in '71. John Lennon's message of peace still resonates today. Which track moves you most?

events.title: First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember life before streaming? 25 years ago, the first iPod changed everything. Did you get one of the originals, or were you a later adopter?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day commemorates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 movie moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Walks
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's the sketch or character that always makes you laugh?

events.title: The 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Beatles Double Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' ambitious 'White Album' dropped this month in '68. Its diverse tracks showed a band pushing boundaries. What's your hidden gem from the album?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We mark the 35th anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Showman
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: A New Direction
angles.copy: On this day in '65, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' arrived, marking a shift in their sound. Which track from this influential album is still on your playlist?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We mark the 46th anniversary of the tragic passing of music legend John Lennon, who died on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Peace & Legacy
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace are as vital today as ever. What does his legacy mean to you?
